scripts.cp-mac: cargo build --release && rm -rfv builds/* && node scripts/cp-version.js && scp builds/* rsync-user@calcit-lang.org:/web-assets/repo/calcit-lang/binaries/macos/
scripts.bench-recur-smoke: cargo run --bin cr -- calcit/test.cirru js && node --input-type=module -e "import { test_loop } from './js-out/test-recursion.main.mjs'; const n=3000; const t0=process.hrtime.bigint(); for(let i=0;i<n;i++) test_loop(); const dt=Number(process.hrtime.bigint()-t0)/1e6; console.log('test_loop_ms='+dt.toFixed(3));"
scripts.check-smooth: yarn fmt-rs && yarn lint-rs && yarn test-rs && yarn check-all
scripts.check-all: yarn compile && yarn try-rs && yarn try-js && yarn try-ir
scripts.try-js-brk: cargo run --bin cr -- calcit/test.cirru js && node --inspect-brk js-out/main.mjs
scripts.try-js: cargo run --bin cr -- calcit/test.cirru js && node js-out/main.mjs
